title: A synthetic study of baseline CRT-HD scores and lifecycle maintenance costs in a fleet of load-bearing widgets

exhibits.label: table_01
exhibits.caption: Table 1. Primary and secondary associations between baseline CRT-HD total score and each outcome
exhibits.notes: CRT-HD, Composite Rig Test (Heavy Duty); DI-4, Durability Index 4. Costs are GBP per unit per year. All models adjusted for unit age, duty class, and rated working load. Estimates in bold reached p < 0.01.

summary: This invented study describes an entirely synthetic fleet of load-bearing widgets and structural brackets under a depot maintenance contract. It reports associations between baseline CRT-HD (Heavy Duty) total scores and lifecycle maintenance costs, DI-4 durability index, inspection visits, and unplanned removal in a fabricated dataset used only to exercise the meltiro test suite.
